reuse.why: Extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend and reuses RSchedule/recurConfigToRSchedule, but the weekend-or-holiday predicate and the daily-skip rule are rebuilt in each caller instead of shared.

duplication.why: The isSkippedDay closure is written three times plus inline once, and the daily-skip rule is implemented three separate ways (loops in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates, a continue in getDatesInRange).

placement.why: Holiday matching lives in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-frequency rule is spread across shared/schedules.ts and two server handlers rather than defined beside the adjustment helper.

scope.why: Changes stay within schedule date handling, the type and tests.

maintainability.why: A future change to which days are skipped or how daily schedules behave must be made in three or four places, and the range query relies on an ad hoc 3 + holidays.length padding.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange re-implement the daily skip and the weekend/holiday predicate instead of going through a shared helper in shared/schedules.ts

disguised_duplication.where: daily-skip appears as a reverse-aware while loop in getNextDate, a forward re-query loop in getUpcomingDates and a continue in getDatesInRange; the skipped-day predicate is redefined as local isSkippedDay closures in three functions and inlined in a fourth

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate adds a daily-frequency branch around it; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange reimplement the daily case and the predicate locally
